access_log.title: Access Log Configuration
access_log.deploy_mode_tip: Select deployment environment, log path auto-adjusts
access_log.output_target_tip: Choose where to output access logs. stdout is recommended for Kubernetes.
access_log.k8s_stdout_desc_line1: Gateway outputs JSON logs to stdout, Kubernetes auto-redirects to
access_log.k8s_stdout_desc_line2: Fluent Bit DaemonSet can directly collect, no need to configure file paths!
access_log.docker_desc_line2: mode: stdout for collection, file for backup.
access_log.docker_desc_line3: Ensure volume mount configured in docker run or compose!
access_log.storage_hint_msg: Logs are collected in real-time, not stored in database
access_log.storage_hint_desc: For persistent storage and historical queries, refer to the configurations below to integrate with Elasticsearch. Future versions will provide built-in ES integration.
access_log.collection_k8s_msg: Cloud-Native Best Practice: stdout + Fluent Bit DaemonSet
access_log.collection_k8s_desc: Gateway outputs to stdout, Kubernetes auto-redirects to /var/log/containers/*.log. Deploy one Fluent Bit Agent per node for auto-collection.
access_log.collection_docker_sidecar: Sidecar mode: Fluent Bit as sidecar container, shared volume, cleanest
access_log.collection_docker_host: Host Agent: Run Fluent Bit on host, monitor mounted volume path
access_log.collection_local_desc: Run Fluent Bit or Filebeat on host to tail configured log directory (supports wildcards).
access_log.collection_custom_desc: Ensure the path is correct and Fluent Bit has permission to access. Use wildcards like /custom/path/access-*.log
access_log.directory_hint: Default path based on mode, you can customize
access_log.sampling_extra: 100% logs all requests. Production environments recommend 10-30% to balance storage and observability.
access_log.file_both_disabled: file/both disabled: Kubernetes mode recommends stdout only. File output increases I/O overhead and makes cross-node aggregation difficult.
access_log.local_hint_desc: Use file mode. Logs are written to local directory. Can be collected by Fluent Bit or Filebeat via direct tailing.
access_log.custom_hint_desc: Ensure the specified path exists and Gateway has write permissions. Collection Agent needs access to this path.
access_log.console_extra: Also output to console (for K8S log collection)
access_log.info_desc: Each request generates one JSON line in the log file:
access_log.k8s_viewer_desc_realtime: Real-time logs from Pod stdout (last 500 lines).
access_log.k8s_viewer_desc_history: Historical logs from Pod stdout (based on time range).
access_log.k8s_viewer_desc_future: Future versions will integrate ES for persistent storage and historical queries.
access_log.local_viewer_desc: Logs read from local files, supports historical queries. Ensure Gateway access log output to file is enabled.
access_log.history_mode_desc: Query logs from Pod stdout (no database required)
access_log.k8s_auto_switch_msg: Kubernetes mode auto-switched to stdout output, this is cloud-native best practice
